Primary use cases (current quarter)
- Internal knowledge assistant for policy/procedure lookup (employee-only).
- Support-agent assist: summarize customer interactions + draft responses (PII present).

Workload + performance requirements
- Mix of chat + summarization; bursty during business hours.

Security/compliance requirements (highlights)

- Data residency: US-only for all data and derived telemetry.
- Retention controls: strict limits on logs (they cited 14–30 days for app logs; shorter for prompt content; preference to disable prompt logging by default).
